Egalitalia thanks the Confederated States of Pantagruel for their willingness to engage in diplomacy. We gladly accept the proposal for the relinquishment of claims over our territory and look forward to establishing formal diplomatic relations. We also welcome the opportunity for exclusive trade between our nations, and we appreciate the offered 25% lifetime discount on all forms of trade.
